bootstrap_train_model: bootstrap a model for training using _StandardTrainModelBootstrapper with a ModelSection config and asset store
load_custom_model: load a custom model from a file path using _StandardTrainModelBootstrapper with a specified model family and architecture
create_new_model: create a new model from scratch using _StandardTrainModelBootstrapper with a model family name and optional architecture config
prepare_model_for_training: prepare a model holder for training with activation checkpointing and torch compile using _LastTrainModelPreparer
save_model_metadata: save model family name and config metadata to checkpoint directory using _StandardTrainModelMetadataSaver
